items.text: Napilipi Esera, elimori, emonyi akiyo, isudedei koinaren ketogo loka Edeke, kotukokinos neaiai ŋesi koIsirael ekodet loepol noi loka ikiliok ka aijor ka idwe: naarai apotu ituŋa komonyata noi akiyo.

Koboŋok Sekania okoku loka Yekiel, ediopet kodwe luka Elam, kotema Esera atiar, “Kibuea kama ejai Edekewok, aimany aŋor numo nuka atekerin nuka akwap: konye kwape kwana ejai amunonut neejai Isirael kanuka nun,

Aso do ketutukoto aitutuket ka Edekewok aireŋear aŋor kere, ka lueurito kesi, kwape ejaar ainerun naka ejakaitika, ka ŋul luemaranete toma aicorakinet naka Edekewok, ido kiswamaunai kwape eiaar ekisil.
Konyou; naarai akirot nin nakon, isio da kija kajo; kicata, kiswama.”
Kosodi Esera anyoun, kisiyapo iiaka luka isasedotin, ka lebin, ka Isirael kere, ebe kiswamaenenete kwape ejaar akirot ŋin. Kiyapoto do.

Kosodi Esera anyoun koinaren ketogo loka Edeke, koloma agola naka Yekokanan okoku loka Eliasib: kedolo, mam abu konyam atap, karaida aimat akipi: naarai abu kokadak kanuka aibucar naka nul kaluka aijoreorio.
Aponi kolimoroi anatar Yuda ka Yerusalem, mama ejaas idwe kere luka aijoreorio, kotukonokinos Yerusalem;
Ido yenimam ebuni toma apak naka apaarasia auni, kwape ejaar ainerun naka ikapolok ka imakio, kotwania ikeboro kere, ka ŋes elopet kogelarai kokodet loka aijoreorio.

Kosodete ituŋa kere luka Yuda ka Benyamin kotukonokinos Yerusalem kotoma apaarasia auni; kerai elap lokikanyetekaonon, kapaaran naka akaisaarei naka elap: kiboikinos ituŋa kere aibois naelal koinaren ketogo loka Edeke, komaranete kanuka akirot kaŋin, kanuka akiru da naapol noi.
Kobwo Esera esasedoti kolimok kes ebe, “Ipotu kibucasi komanya aŋor numo, kosodete aiyatakin adiakar koIsirael.
Aso do kolimosi mama ejai EJAKAIT, Edeke loka lukapapaakus, kiswamata nuitojokit ŋesi: kogitaros katekerin nuka akwap, ka aŋor numo da.”
Kosodi ekodet kere aboŋokin keporoto loepol ebe, “Kwape inerar ijo akirokosi, kwape kwaŋin kibusakinitor aswam.
Konye ipu ituŋa, ido ŋes apak naka akiru naepol, mam kipedori aibwo kokina, ido na mere ŋes aswam naka apaaran adiopet arai aarei: naarai kibuea noi kakirot kana.

Aso koseunai ikapolokokosi kokodet kere, ka nul kere luejaas toma oreriakosi luemanyito aŋor numo kopotu kapakio nueseunitai, ido nepepe kanul, imakio luka nolirc, ka ikatubokoke, aitodol neibelokinor anyunyura naededen naka Edekewok anyoun kamawok, aitodol naedaunor akirot nin.”
Konye kobwaata Yonatan okoku loka Asakel ka Yaseia okoku loka Tikuba aiŋer akirot na: kiganakis kes Mesulam ka Sabetai Elebit,

Kiswamata idwe luka aijoreorio kwaŋin. Kotiakunai Esera esasedoti, ka ice kokapolok luka ikekia luka lukapapaakec, kwape ajaatar ikekia luka lukapapaakec, kes kere ebilitai ikecekiroria; kiboikinos kapaaran nasodit naka elap lokitomonet aiŋic akirot ŋin.
Kodautu akiro nuka ikiliok kere luamanyito aŋor numo koroko apaaran nasodit naka elap losodit etuboro.
Kotakanut kodwe luka isasedotin luamanyito aŋor numo: kodwe luka Yesua, okoku loka Yosadak, ka iinacanake, Maaseia, ka Elieser, ka Yarib, ka Gedalia.
Apotu koriosi akecekanin kwape ireneariata do akecenor; ido naarai agwaunito akiro, koinakis emerekek lokosipan kanuka agwaunikec.
Kodwe luka Imer; Kanani ka Sebadia.
Kodwe luka Karim; Maaseia, ka Eliya, ka Semaia, ka Yekiel, ka Usia.
Kodwe luka Pasur; Elioenai, Maaseia, Isimael, Netanel, Yosabad, ka Elasa.
KoLebin; Yosabad, ka Simei, ka Kelaia (ŋes ŋol Kelita), Petakia, Yuda ka Elieser.
Kokayook: Eliasib: kokagolok; Salum, ka Telem, ka Uri.
KoIsirael: kodwe luka Paros; Ramia, ka Isia, ka Malakiya, ka Miyamin, ka Eleasar, ka Malakiya, ka Benaia,
Kodwe luka Elam; Matania, ka Sekaria, ka Yekiel, ka Abidi, ka Yeremot, ka Eliya.
Kodwe luka Satu; Elioenai, Eliasib, Matania, ka Yeremot, ka Sabad, ka Asisa.
Kodwe luka Bebai; Yekokanan, Kanania, Sabai, Atalai,
Kodwe luka Bani; Mesulam, ka Maluk, ka Adaia, ka Yasub, ka Seal, ka Yercmot,
Kodwe luka Pakat-moab; Adana ka Kelal, ka Benaia, ka Maaseia, ka Matania, ka Besalel, ka Binui, ka Manase.
Kodwe luka Karim; Elieser, ka Isiya, ka Malakiya, ka. Semaia, ka Simeon;
Kodwe luka Kasum; Matenai, ka Matata, ka Sabad, ka Elipelet, ka Yeremai, ka Manase, ka Simei.
Kodwe luka Bani; Maadai, ka Amuram, ka Uel;
ka Bani, ka Binui, ka Simei,
ka Selemia, ka Natan, ka Adaia;
Kodwc luka Nebo; Yeiel, ka Matitia, ka Sabad, ka Sebina, ka Ido, ka Yoel, ka Benaia.
Ŋul kere amanyito aŋor numo; ajaas ke kakesi aŋor nuauritotor idwe.
